title: FNAF 6 AM
blurb: Six in the morning, the two sweetest words in Five Nights at Freddy's. The cheer, the bell chime and the little rising jingle together mean you survived the shift and get to add another four dollars and change to your paycheque. Nothing else in the game comes close. Anyone who played the original in 2014 knows this as genuine Pavlovian relief, the sound of the animatronics powering down and your heart rate following them. Excellent for marking the end of anything unbearable — a shift, an exam, a meeting that should have been an email.
origin: The 6 AM survival chime from Five Nights at Freddy's.
